title: What changes after deployment? A survey on On-device Learning in TinyML
authors: Massimo Pavan, Luca Pezzarossa, Fabrizio Pittorino, et al.
abstract: Machine learning models on microcontroller-class devices (TinyML) face a fundamental challenge: post-deployment distribution change undermines static models.
